A1.justification: Both PDFs describe AutoV and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. Relocated and renumbered material can be matched reliably across versions.

before.justification: v3 reports original benchmark evaluations, retrieval comparisons, ablations, efficiency measurements, and statistical and teacher-scale analyses.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results and adds a qualitative retrieval failure case in Appendix H.1.

M1.justification: Following Equation (2), v3 defines the fused text features as T_tilde = product_i H_i[-l_t:], whereas v4 uses H_i[-l_t:] directly. This locally revises the ranking computation as specified. The remaining architecture, reward loss, and inference filtering are retained; the PDFs do not establish whether implementation or experimental execution changed.

E1.justification: The training sources and reported benchmark coverage are retained. The seven-benchmark extended evaluation moves from v3 Table 2 to v4 Appendix E, Table 8. The added failure example remains within the existing visual-question-answering task coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain FGVP, RedCircle/Circle, API, and the fixed-prompt, random, regression, MoE, and list-wise retrieval alternatives. Comparator membership is unchanged in Table 1 and the retrieval comparison renumbered from Table 3 to Table 2.

E3.justification: Previously specified experimental settings are retained, including the backbones and Appendix C's 40 epochs, batch size 64, learning rate 1e-3, and eight A100-40G GPUs. Appendix B removes generic BLEU/CIDEr examples without specifying a changed captioning evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: v4 adds a failure-case analysis in Appendix H.1 and Figure 7, examining retrieval that misses a mirror cue in an abstract question. Existing retrieval, pool-size, layer-selection, filtering, teacher-scale, and loss-reliability analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Section 5.7 and Table 9 retain the paired t-tests and five seeds, 10 through 50. The reported mean improvement, standard deviation, and p-value are unchanged in the statistical appendix, renumbered from F to G.

E6.justification: The new failure case reports AutoV's ranking of 2 > 1 > 3 > 4 and its incorrect selection of VP2. Numerical entries in the matched tables are unchanged. Section 4.2 condenses the earlier per-model improvements into a 3.5% overall summary.

T1.justification: The definition following Equation (2) removes the product over candidate outputs from the fused text-feature expression. This changes a mathematical definition beyond equivalent notation. The other equations, including the reward loss and Appendix A's attention-prompt formula, are unchanged; no proofs or theorems are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about adaptive prompt retrieval, automatic loss-based supervision, and transferability. The highlighted 10.2% VizWiz and 3.8% MMMU improvement examples are unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix H.1 newly attributes a failure to semantic relevance misleading retrieval when an abstract query requires noticing a reflected visual cue. This adds a concrete failure condition to the otherwise retained interpretations of robustness and generalization.

D1.justification: v4 adds an explicit code-repository link on the first page, absent from v3. Appendix C's hardware, annotation time, and training hyperparameters remain unchanged. Appendix B drops the earlier BLEU/CIDEr metric examples.

R1.justification: Appendix A.1 adds citations to SparseVLM, FreeKD+, and ChainV while dropping DINOv2. References to COCO Captions, BLEU, and CIDEr are also removed. The main related-work discussion and positioning of AutoV remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 makes limited prose edits, condenses Section 4.2, expands discussion of the relocated extended evaluation in Appendix E, and adds a failure subsection and acknowledgements. Author information and running headers are updated; most wording and the main section order are retained.

P2.justification: v4 adds failure Figure 7, renumbers the training example as Figure 8, and moves the extended evaluation table into Appendix E. Figure 1's caption clarifies the crown symbols, and table spacing and float placement are adjusted. Existing visualizations and table structures are largely retained.

improvement.justification: The added failure analysis, explicit code pointer, and clearer Figure 1 caption modestly improve transparency and usability while retaining the empirical evidence. Existing reporting problems remain unresolved: for example, Table 9's listed gains average 2.46%, while both versions report 2.06%. The revision therefore provides limited overall gains.
